sections.heading: On-Site Medical Solutions for Hotels & Resorts
sections.subheading: Because Guest Safety Is Part of Your Hotel Experience.
body: A medical emergency should never become an operational crisis for your hotel. 24/7 Clinic brings professional urgent care directly into the hospitality environment, combining medical expertise with the service standards your guests expect.

From immediate medical response and multilingual assistance to insurance coordination and discreet VIP care, we take responsibility for the medical side of the guest experience, allowing your team to focus on hospitality.
Medicine is our responsibility. Your guests remain your priority.

sections.heading: When Medical Incidents Become Hotel Challenges
body: Medicine is not your business.
But the consequences of a medical incident can become yours.

items.title: Medical Emergencies
items.text: Unexpected illness and injuries requiring a fast, professional medical response.

items.title: Guest Anxiety & Complaints
items.text: Uncertainty, delays and inadequate medical support can negatively affect the guest experience.

items.title: Staff Under Pressure
items.text: Front-office, guest relations and security teams are often expected to handle situations beyond their medical expertise.

items.title: Operational & Reputational Risk
items.text: Poorly managed medical incidents can affect guest satisfaction, online reviews and hotel reputation.

sections.heading: Healthcare Designed Around the Guest Experience
body: 24/7 Clinic combines professional medical care with the expectations of modern hospitality. Our approach goes beyond treating patients. We provide a coordinated, discreet and guest-focused medical experience that integrates naturally with hotel operations.

sections.heading: Medical Clinics Inside Hotels & Resorts
body: More than a medical facility inside your hotel, 24/7 Clinic is a fully managed urgent care solution designed around the needs of international guests and hotel operations.
One medical partner. Less operational pressure. A better guest experience.

sections.heading: The American Urgent Care Model. Adapted for Hospitality.
sections.subheading: A Proven Model Adapted to Hospitality
body: Our healthcare approach is inspired by the American urgent care model, with a focus on timely medical access, patient-centred service, efficient coordination and appropriate treatment without unnecessary hospital referrals.
A recognised healthcare model, adapted to the unique needs of hotels and resorts.

sections.heading: Professional Medical Care Without Leaving the Resort
sections.subheading: What an On-Site Clinic Can Provide
body: Our on-site clinics provide access to medical assessment, treatment and coordinated care within the hospitality environment, allowing guests to receive appropriate medical attention with greater convenience and less disruption to their stay.
All services are subject to clinical assessment, facility capabilities and applicable licensing requirements.

sections.heading: Your Hotel Focuses on Hospitality. We Manage Healthcare.
body: 24/7 Clinic offers a fully managed medical operating model designed to reduce the complexity of providing healthcare services within a hotel.
One dedicated healthcare partner. One coordinated operating model.

sections.heading: A Partnership Model Built Around Your Property
body: We understand that every hotel operates differently. Our partnerships are structured according to the property’s location, capacity, guest profile, available space and medical service requirements.
Low complexity for your hotel. High value for your guests.

sections.heading: A Healthcare Partnership That Strengthens Your Hotel
body: Professional medical support is more than an operational necessity. It can strengthen guest confidence, support premium positioning and make your property more attractive to travellers who value safety, convenience and access to healthcare.

items.title: Greater Appeal to Families & Senior Guests
No Need to Manage Healthcare Operations Internally

sections.heading: Let’s Build a Safer Hotel Together
body: Every hotel has different operational needs, guest profiles and service standards. We develop flexible medical partnership models adapted to each property, from on-site urgent care clinics to coordinated medical support for hotel guests.
